title: Ordinary coefficient cone compatibility with direct image
statement:
Let $l$ be prime, let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes with diagonal localizations, and let $p$ be a presentation with $E=\mathbf Q_l$ (in its recorded universe lift) [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation]. Write $N_T$ for the coefficient system, $H_T=r_TN_T$, $M_T$ for the completed coefficient module, and $c_T:U_TM_T\to\lim H_T$ for the cone lift of its recorded coefficient projections [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-coefficients]. Let $b:M_S\to f_*M_X$ be completedPushUnit [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-finite-evaluation], let $\alpha:N_S\to f_*N_X$ be the ordinary adjunct of the specified coefficient pullback [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal], and put $\beta=r_S(\alpha)\,v^{\mathrm{ord}}_{N_X}$. Then
\[U_S(b)\,c^{\mathrm{ord}}_{M_X}\,f_*(c_X)\,\lambda^{\mathrm{ord}}_{H_X}=c_S\,\lim(\beta).\]
Composition is written in application order, and $c^{\mathrm{ord}}$ and $\lambda^{\mathrm{ord}}$ are the presentation's completed and limit ordinary comparisons.

proof.text: Apply ordinary limit extensionality. The limit.post projection identity and cone lift equations reduce the claim to the levelwise coefficient cone square.

Forget scalars faithfully and compose with coefficientForget. The completed_sections and varying_sections equations identify the direct-image comparisons with the identity on sections. coefficient_projection identifies the cone arrows with the actual completed ring projections.

The coefficientPullback normalization identifies the ordinary adjunct with finite constant-ring restriction. Additivity and coefficient_one identify the coefficient comparisons locally on finite constant sections, which are integer multiples of one. Descent identifies the sheaf maps. The definition of diagonalCompletedCoefficientMap as a limit lift gives the remaining finite ring square.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_coefficient_cone_push
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S} (p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f) :
    let E := ULift.{u} (Padic l)
    let H := p.restrictionX.F.obj (SpTowerClasses.coefficient X (SpTowerClasses.Arings l E X))
    (diagonalCompletedRestriction l S).map (completedPushUnit l f) ≫
        p.completedOrdinary.hom.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit (Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion X l))) ≫
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ_[l])) f).map
          (limit.lift H ⟨_, p.coefficientsX.coefficientProjection⟩) ≫
        p.limits.ordinary.hom.app H =
      limit.lift _ ⟨_, p.coefficientsS.coefficientProjection⟩ ≫
        (lim : DiagonalSystems l S ⥤ DiagonalMod l S).map
          (p.restrictionS.F.map
              ((p.model.geometry.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _)
                p.model.coefficientPullback.iso.hom) ≫
            p.varyingOrdinary.hom.app
              (SpTowerClasses.coefficient X (SpTowerClasses.Arings l E X)))
